2607.19064.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
2607.19064.paper_summary: Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding with anchor-latent regularization, preserving the reconstruction quality of strong public VAEs while reducing tokenization cost by more than an order of magnitude. Together with native-resolution packing and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion, the stack supports flexible-resolution training and improves end-to-end training throughput by about $2.5\times$. Built on this foundation, we develop a complete model family with Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants for both generation and editing. Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering, aesthetic quality, and editing fidelity, while few-step distillation with adversarial perceptual guidance produces 4-step Turbo models for low-latency inference. Despite its compact scale, Mage-Flow and Mage-Flow-Edit achieves competitive performance across standard generation and editing benchmarks. More importantly, the Turbo variants make high-resolution generation and editing practical for interactive use: at $1024^2$ resolution on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, Mage-Flow-Turbo generates an image in 0.59s, and Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo edits an image in 1.02s, while maintaining a small memory footprint. These results show that careful tokenizer--backbone--system co-design can deliver strong high-resolution generation and editing within an efficient 4B model family.
2607.19064.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺生成器的能力日益增強，但訓練、微調和部署的成本也相對較高。<lb/>我們介紹了Mage-Flow，一個緊湊的4B規模生成堆疊，用於高效的文本到圖像生成和基於指令的圖像編輯。<lb/>該堆疊由兩個共同設計的組件組成：Mage-VAE，一個輕量級高保真潛在標記器，以及一個使用修正流匹配訓練的原生分辨率多模態擴散Transformer。<lb/>Mage-VAE使用一步擴散風格的編碼和解碼，並結合錨點潛在正則化，保持強大公共VAE的重建質量，同時將標記化成本降低了超過一個數量級。<lb/>結合原生分辨率打包和堆疊級CUDA內核融合，該堆疊支持靈活的分辨率訓練，並將端到端訓練吞吐量提高了約$2.5\times$。<lb/>在此基礎上，我們開發了一個完整的模型家族，包括基礎、與RL對齊和Turbo變體，適用於生成和編輯。<lb/>Diffusion-NFT改善了提示跟隨、文本渲染、美學質量和編輯保真度，而使用對抗感知指導的少步驟蒸餾則生成了4步驟的Turbo模型，以實現低延遲推斷。<lb/>儘管其規模緊湊，Mage-Flow和Mage-Flow-Edit在標準生成和編輯基準上達到了競爭性能。<lb/>更重要的是，Turbo變體使得高分辨率生成和編輯在互動使用中變得可行：在單個NVIDIA A100 GPU上以$1024^2$的分辨率，Mage-Flow-Turbo在0.59秒內生成一幅圖像，而Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo在1.02秒內編輯一幅圖像，同時保持小的內存佔用。<lb/>這些結果顯示，仔細的標記器-骨幹-系統共同設計可以在高效的4B模型家族內提供強大的高分辨率生成和編輯能力。
